Street Fighter (2026): Fresh or Rotten? Critics vs. Fans and the Franchise's 38-Point Gulf 🥊

carousel // Oct 20, 2026

Read more on Threads

The new Street Fighter (2026) movie started an absolute war between critics and fans. 🥊

Critics gave it 44%. Fans gave it 82%. That's a 38-point gulf. Is it a trash adaptation, or are critics completely out of touch with how game movies are supposed to feel?

Here's the whole fight, slide by slide. (Scores were still moving when I made this, so treat them as a snapshot.)

Slide 1: How do fans really feel?

82% Popcornmeter vs. 44% critics. Is this the first Street Fighter movie fans actually love?

Slide 2: Critics vs. fans

44% on the Tomatometer from 70-plus critic reviews. 82% on the Popcornmeter from 500-plus verified ratings. A 38-point gulf.

Slide 3: From 28% to the mid-40s

It debuted at 28% in its first 25 reviews and climbed to about 44% once 70-plus reviews were in. Still rotten, but climbing.

Slide 4: Team Rotten

The critics call it a tonal mess that swings between deadly serious and parody, say it barely feels like a complete movie, and call the screenplay cluttered and the editing frustratingly uneven.

Slide 5: Team Fresh

On the other side: "Works the way fans would want a big-screen Street Fighter to work," and "never letting good sense get in the way of a good time." And 82% of fans agree.

Slide 6: Franchise face-off

The franchise has always been an uphill fight. JCVD's original Street Fighter (1994) is a nostalgic camp classic, but it sits at a dismal 12% with critics. The Legend of Chun-Li (2009)? A near-unanimous 3% K.O.

So while about 44% sounds low, it's actually the best critical showing a Street Fighter movie has ever had. Progress, right? 😅

Slide 7: Fresh or rotten?

Team Fresh 🟢 or Team Rotten 🟣? Seen it? Declare your side.

Slide 8: Drop your verdict

Fresh or rotten? Score it 1 to 10.

Wrestling fans, look twice

The cast has a Wrestling Wars crossover: Roman Reigns plays Akuma and Cody Rhodes plays Guile. If you're still deciding who really runs wrestling, now you've got two more matches to judge them on.

Sources: Fightful: Street Fighter debuts with 34% on Rotten Tomatoes, Esports.gg: Street Fighter movie review roundup, ComicBookMovie: Street Fighter Rotten Tomatoes score, Gagadget: Street Fighter opens to $51.1M

Quick answers

What is Street Fighter (2026) rated on Rotten Tomatoes? When I made this, it was around 44% with critics and 82% on the audience Popcornmeter. Scores were still changing.

Is Street Fighter (2026) better reviewed than the old movies? Yes. Street Fighter (1994) sits at 12% with critics and The Legend of Chun-Li (2009) at 3%, so the 2026 movie is the franchise's best critical showing so far.

Are Roman Reigns and Cody Rhodes in the Street Fighter movie? Yes. Roman Reigns plays Akuma and Cody Rhodes plays Guile.

How much did Street Fighter (2026) make opening weekend? About $51.1 million worldwide, a franchise record, though below some analysts' expectations.

Your turn

Fresh or rotten? Score it 1 to 10 in the comments. 👇
